mapper.select: SELECT c.course_id, c.mountain_id, c.rev_no, COALESCE(ST_SRID(c.geom) = 5179 AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(c.geom) AND ST_IsValid(c.geom), false) AS geometry_valid FROM course c WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} AND c.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND c.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trail_spot s WHERE s.mountain_id = #{mountainId} AND s.dup_of_spot_id IS NULL AND s.verify_status_cd <> 'REJECTED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM spot_tag t WHERE t.spot_id = s.spot_id AND t.verify_status_cd <> 'REJECTED' ) )

SELECT s.spot_id, s.src_class_nm, s.detail_txt, ROUND(ST_Distance(c.geom, s.geom)::numeric, 1) AS distance_m, (SELECT MIN(m.dist_m) FROM spot_edge_match m WHERE m.spot_id = s.spot_id AND m.match_status_cd <> 'REJECTED') AS match_distance_m, s.verify_status_cd, ST_X(ST_Transform(s.geom, 4326)) AS longitude, ST_Y(ST_Transform(s.geom, 4326)) AS latitude FROM course c JOIN trail_spot s ON s.mountain_id = c.mountain_id AND ST_DWithin(c.geom, s.geom, #{radiusM}) WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} AND ORDER BY distance_m, s.spot_id

SELECT t.spot_id, t.tag_cd, t.verify_status_cd, t.extract_type_cd FROM spot_tag t WHERE t.spot_id IN #{spotId} AND t.verify_status_cd <> 'REJECTED' AND t.verify_status_cd = #{verifyStatus} ORDER BY t.spot_id, t.tag_cd

SELECT f.facility_id, f.fac_type_cd, f.fac_nm, f.addr, ROUND(ST_Distance(c.geom, f.geom)::numeric, 1) AS distance_m, f.loc_basis_cd, f.verify_status_cd, ST_X(ST_Transform(f.geom, 4326)) AS longitude, ST_Y(ST_Transform(f.geom, 4326)) AS latitude FROM course c JOIN facility f ON f.mountain_id = c.mountain_id AND ST_DWithin(c.geom, f.geom, #{radiusM}) WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} AND f.dup_of_facility_id IS NULL AND f.verify_status_cd <> 'REJECTED' AND f.fac_type_cd = #{type} ORDER BY distance_m, f.facility_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mountain WHERE mountain_id = #{mountainId} AND use_yn = 'Y')
SELECT count(*)::integer FROM trail_edge e WHERE e.mountain_id = #{mountainId} AND e.pass_yn = 'Y' AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(e.geom) AND e.edge_id IN #{edgeId}

WITH route AS () SELECT s.spot_id, s.src_class_nm, s.detail_txt, ROUND(ST_Distance(r.geom, s.geom)::numeric, 1) AS distance_m, (SELECT MIN(m.dist_m) FROM spot_edge_match m WHERE m.spot_id = s.spot_id AND m.match_status_cd <> 'REJECTED') AS match_distance_m, s.verify_status_cd, ST_X(ST_Transform(s.geom, 4326)) AS longitude, ST_Y(ST_Transform(s.geom, 4326)) AS latitude FROM route r JOIN trail_spot s ON s.mountain_id = #{mountainId} AND ST_DWithin(r.geom, s.geom, #{radiusM}) WHERE ORDER BY distance_m, s.spot_id

WITH route AS () SELECT f.facility_id, f.fac_type_cd, f.fac_nm, f.addr, ROUND(ST_Distance(r.geom, f.geom)::numeric, 1) AS distance_m, f.loc_basis_cd, f.verify_status_cd, ST_X(ST_Transform(f.geom, 4326)) AS longitude, ST_Y(ST_Transform(f.geom, 4326)) AS latitude FROM route r JOIN facility f ON f.mountain_id = #{mountainId} AND ST_DWithin(r.geom, f.geom, #{radiusM}) WHERE f.dup_of_facility_id IS NULL AND f.verify_status_cd <> 'REJECTED' ORDER BY distance_m, f.facility_id

SELECT s.spot_id, s.mountain_id, s.dataset_id, s.src_spot_id, s.src_class_nm, s.detail_txt, s.etc_txt, s.verify_status_cd, s.dup_of_spot_id, ST_X(ST_Transform(s.geom, 4326)) AS longitude, ST_Y(ST_Transform(s.geom, 4326)) AS latitude FROM trail_spot s WHERE s.spot_id = #{spotId}
SELECT m.edge_id, m.dist_m, m.pos_ratio, m.match_type_cd, m.match_status_cd FROM spot_edge_match m WHERE m.spot_id = #{spotId} ORDER BY m.dist_m, m.edge_id

SELECT f.facility_id, f.mountain_id, f.fac_type_cd, f.fac_nm, f.addr, f.loc_basis_cd, f.verify_status_cd, f.dup_of_facility_id, d.dataset_id, d.dataset_nm, d.provider_nm, TO_CHAR(d.base_de, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS base_de, TO_CHAR(d.collect_de, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS collect_de, ST_X(ST_Transform(f.geom, 4326)) AS longitude, ST_Y(ST_Transform(f.geom, 4326)) AS latitude FROM facility f JOIN source_dataset d ON d.dataset_id = f.dataset_id WHERE f.facility_id = #{facilityId}
